categories.description: What we measure on site visits.

posts.title: Start with the cable route, not the charger
posts.excerpt: Why the first measurement on a site visit is the run from the distribution board to the far bays.
posts.content:
A site assessment starts with the cable tray, not the charger. On a recent visit to an office car park we measured the run from the main distribution board to the far bays before we talked about hardware at all.

The measured route was 38 metres along an existing ceiling tray, with two junctions that needed a fire-stopped penetration. That single measurement decided where the wall units could go, and it is the reason the written report lists the cable route before the price.

If you are preparing for a visit, mark the main intake and any spare conduit on a plan, and ask your facilities contact to meet us at the car park entrance. The rest we bring with us.
